searchText: **CONSIGNMENT** Used Newmar RV for sale - 2018 Newmar Ventana 4037 is approximately 40' 10' in length with 82,991 miles and 3 slides. Features Full Wall Slide Out Bath and a Half King Bed Hide-A-Bed Sofa More About This RV You can head out for any trip with this triple slide out Ventana 4037 class A motor home! The full wall slide out along the roadside helps to maximize the floor space throughout this model. Your guests can use the convenient half bathroom while in the rear you will find a bath suite with a 36' radius shower plus a spot for a washer and dryer! In the living area there is a 92' hide-a-bed sofa plus a 74' jack knife sofa. You can easily sleep a few campers at the hide-a-bed sofa, the dinette, and for mom and dad come retreat to the bedroom where you will find a queen bed! For true comfort and relaxation on any trip whether you are traveling near or far you will want a Newmar Ventana class A diesel motor home. These models are a cut above the rest with frameless double-pane tinted safety glass windows and a skylight above the shower which adds plenty of natural light. You will love the Bermuda glazed Maple cabinets and the polished solid surface counter tops in the kitchen. When you need to get a little work done then simply set up the passenger seat work station. The polished porcelain tile floor in the kitchen, bathroom, and living room is beautiful, easy to clean, and durable! Get ready for any adventure with a Newmar Ventana!
